title: Underwriting Guide: Vehicle Age, Value and Loss Payee Limits for Physical Damage Coverage
content:
The Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) is written only on vehicles within the limits of the package chosen. Vehicle age is measured in model years before the current model year. The value limits apply to the vehicle's value at binding, which is its clean retail valuation.

| Package | Oldest vehicle eligible (model years before the current model year) | Lowest value at binding (USD) | Highest value at binding (USD) | Available with a loss payee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | 25 | 1500 | 40000 | No |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 20 | 2000 | 50000 | No |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | 20 | 2500 | 60000 | No |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 15 | 3000 | 75000 | Yes |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 15 | 4000 | 75000 | Yes |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | 12 | 5000 | 75000 | Yes |

### Limits common to all six packages

- **Lienholder maximum deductible.** The highest deductible a lienholder or lessor accepts on a financed or leased vehicle is 1000 USD.
- **Coverages per vehicle.** Each scheduled vehicle carries 1 physical damage coverage per owner term.
- **Coverage parts.** Each package provides two coverage parts, collision and comprehensive.
- **Photo inspection.** A photo inspection is required in every package unless it is waived.

### Hypothetical illustrations

Each case below is invented to show how the table reads; none of them describes an actual vehicle.

- **Value just inside a limit.** A vehicle valued at 2500 USD at binding is within the value limits of the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible package. It is below the 3000 USD lowest value of the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible package.
- **Age 15 versus 16.** A vehicle 15 model years old falls within the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible and Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible limits. A vehicle 16 model years old falls outside them.
- **Loss payee column.** A vehicle with a listed loss payee can be placed only on a package marked Yes in the last column. Those are the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible, Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible and Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible packages.
